summary: Tested new ROI backend endpoints, Case Studies + ROI Calculator sections, dark contrast fixes, and Industries overlay fix. All 7 pytest cases passed (health, ROI valid create with computed fields, 3x invalid payloads returning 422, list ROI leads, contact regression). Frontend Playwright verified: nav-link-case-studies + nav-link-roi present; all 5 case cards render; all 7 ROI inputs render; empty submit shows 6 inline validation errors + error toast; valid submit renders roi-result with 3 pie charts showing 35%/55%/35% and heading 'Projected impact for AcmeCo'; projected values 4.5 people and 260 hrs/wk match backend. Contact 'FULL NAME' label computed color rgb(23,23,23) confirming near-black text-neutral-900. Industries images load fully (naturalWidth > 1600) with bottom-only gradient overlay.

issues: Recharts prints repeated console warnings 'width(-1) height(-1)' on initial render because ResponsiveContainer's parent .h-32.w-32 briefly reports 0 before layout. Cosmetic only — charts render correctly. Consider giving ResponsiveContainer explicit width/height or adding minWidth={0}.

critical_code_review_comments: RoiCalculator.jsx (~340 lines) is nearing the size threshold; consider extracting RoiResult + StatCard into their own files for maintainability.
Recharts ResponsiveContainer inside a fixed 128x128 wrapper triggers width/height(-1) warnings; not breaking but noisy in console.
Contact.jsx uses text-neutral-500 placeholder color for regular inputs but text-neutral-400 for textarea placeholder — minor inconsistency in placeholder styling.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_-prefixed ROI leads and one TEST_ contact via pytest run.
